How to play

  • Tap a piece, then tap the one beside it — or swipe — to swap them.
  • Line up 3 or more of a kind to collect them: fire-rings, gold coins, feathers, horseshoes, moonstones and suns.
  • Line up 4 and you make a lit fire-ring: swap it with anything and it clears a whole row or column in a burst of light.
  • Line up 5 and you make a Lantern. Swap it into a glowing ring on the board to light it.
  • Matching on the cold mist melts it away. Deep fog is thicker — it takes two matches on the same square.
  • Some levels hide lost treasures under the mist and fog. Clear the square hiding one to find it.
  • Finish every goal before your moves run out. Each level you win repairs one piece of its door — six repairs bring a door back, and five doors bring back the Hall.
